pr.body:
Corrects the native-v3 cgroup completeness false negative when CPU/cpuset are available at the true root but not enabled for its children. `harness/attest.py` preserves raw interface states and independently proves full ancestry, namespace/mount visibility and controller applicability. Every applicable ancestor limit remains enforced, including above a disabled child subtree.

Only `harness/attest.py` changes production executable behavior. Frozen candidate S/T, the approved contract, A/B/C bindings, prior executable repairs and the authoritative diagnosis package remain unchanged. Signed allocation remains required and unsupplied; A preflight stays BLOCKED pending independent executable re-review and full admission.

Validation on Python 3.12.14: 368/368 full deterministic tests, 55/55 unchanged contract static tests, and 104/104 pure resource-attestation/verifier tests. The diagnosed-host fixture passes cgroup completeness only. All 16 required rejection classes are covered by 33 controller rejection tests plus two additional raw timeline rejection tests; zero failures, errors or skips.

PAPER ONLY. No fresh preflight, A/B/C, native service workload, source-frame release, slot consumption or host/cloud configuration change. Stage E RED; Stage F NOT STARTED. STOP FOR ASTRA/OWNER.
